summary: Steep kerb on a through road, with homes about 11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m and 15 m from the kerb on the same side, with more homes around the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane beside a parked car; room to stop at the kerb. Whole stretch is too steep.
drivers.traffic: Through road with lane markings at a junction; steady passing traffic likely.
drivers.convention: One car parked on the stretch, so some parking, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: 11% mean, 12.6% max over the 24 m
Mapped gate 113 m away on a side path, not on the only access
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy and house shade over the western half, morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: north kerb of Keltie Street at the junction corner, where a car is parked
